subject: Unexpected charge on our August invoice
body:
Hello Support,

We were charged $240 instead of our usual $160 this month on invoice #INV-8821. We haven't added any new users. Could you please check why this was increased and issue a refund for the difference?

Thanks,
Marcus
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for reaching out. Regarding invoice #INV-8821, if guest accounts in your shared inbox were upgraded to full collaborator seats, that results in a prorated charge of $80. If these upgrades were made in error, our team can revert those seats to guest permissions and apply an $80 credit to your upcoming billing cycle. Please let us know how you'd like to proceed!

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team
key_points: Offer $80 credit and revert seats if error

subject: Need W-9 form and updated annual receipt
body:
Hi,

Our accounting department needs Hiver's signed W-9 form and our annual subscription receipt with our VAT ID (EU89210023) listed on it for tax filings.

Thank you,
Elena
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Elena,

Happy to help with this request! I have requested our billing team to provide Hiver's signed W-9 form and regenerate your annual receipt to reflect your VAT ID (EU89210023). You can also download updated receipts directly from your Billing Settings page once processed.

Please let us know if your tax team requires anything else.

Best,
Hiver Support Team
key_points: Point to Billing Settings for receipt with VAT ID EU89210023

subject: Switching from Monthly to Annual plan discount
body:
Hi Hiver Sales/Support,

We currently have 15 Pro seats on the monthly plan ($49/seat/mo). What discount can you offer if we switch to annual upfront billing today?

Regards,
Sarah Jenkins
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for considering an annual commitment! When switching from monthly to annual billing on our Pro plan, we offer a 20% discount, bringing the price from $49 down to $39 per seat/month (billed as $468/seat/year).

For 15 seats, your annual total would be $7,020, saving your team $1,800 annually. If you'd like me to apply this transition to your next billing cycle, just reply with your confirmation and I'll generate the updated order form.

Best regards,
Hiver Account Management

subject: Refund request after accidental seat addition
body:
Hi,

One of our managers accidentally added 5 extra seats when inviting subcontractors yesterday. We deleted them within 1 hour. Can you confirm we won't be billed for the full month?

Thanks,
Tom
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for reaching out! Since those 5 seats were added and removed within our 24-hour grace window, our billing engine automatically voids unbilled prorated charges. You will not see any extra charge on your upcoming invoice.

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team

subject: Double charge on invoice #INV-4120
body:
Hello Hiver Team,

We noticed a duplicate charge on our credit card statement for our monthly subscription on invoice #INV-4120. We were billed $199 twice on the same day. Could you please check this and issue an immediate refund for the duplicate transaction?

Regards,
Jason Reed
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Jason,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I have flagged invoice #INV-4120 for priority verification with our billing team to inspect the duplicate charge of $199. Once confirmed by our payment gateway records, the billing team can process a full reversal back to your original payment card, which typically reflects within 3 to 5 business days once processed.

I will monitor this ticket and follow up as soon as verification is complete.

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team
key_points: Process full reversal of duplicate charge to card once confirmed (3-5 business days)

subject: Sales tax exemption for 501(c)(3) entity
body:
Hello,

We are a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit and were charged sales tax on our recent invoice. We have attached our tax-exemption certificate. Please update our account and refund the tax portion.

Thank you,
Patricia
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Patricia,

Thank you for sending over your 501(c)(3) determination documentation. I have routed your certificate to our finance team for verification. Once approved, the team can mark your Hiver organization as tax-exempt for future billing cycles and credit the sales tax amount back to your payment method.

Best regards,
Hiver Billing Support
key_points: Update organization to tax-exempt once approved
Credit sales tax amount back within 3-5 business days

subject: Card expired and owner unavailable to update billing
body:
Hi Support,

Our corporate card expired and we received an email saying our subscription is at risk of suspension. Our Account Owner is on medical leave and only owners can access billing settings. Can you extend our grace period and provide a billing update link?

Regards,
Mark
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Mark,

Thank you for reaching out, and no need to worry about service interruption. I have flagged your account for a temporary 7-day grace period extension on your subscription so your workspace will not experience any suspension.

To update your corporate card without the Account Owner present, our billing team can provide a secure one-time billing update link: `https://app.hiverhq.com/billing/update-payment?session=token_88291`. Any authorized admin can enter the new Visa/Mastercard details securely through this portal.

Please let us know once completed so we can confirm the invoice settlement.

Best regards,
Hiver Billing Support
key_points: Provide secure one-time billing update link

subject: Emails failing to sync in shared inbox
body:
Hey team,

Our 'support@' shared inbox stopped pulling emails about 45 minutes ago. New emails sent to that address arrive in the main Google Group but do not show up inside Hiver's shared view.

Need urgent resolution,
Dave
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Dave,

Thanks for alerting us. We investigated and noticed a brief token expiration with Google OAuth across your domain. To restore real-time syncing immediately, please have your Google Workspace Admin open Hiver Settings > Shared Inboxes > support@ and click 'Re-authenticate Google Permissions'.

Once clicked, all pending emails will automatically backfill within 2-3 minutes. Let me know once done so I can confirm health on our end.

Best regards,
Hiver Technical Support

subject: Collision detection not triggering on Chrome
body:
Hi Support,

Two of our agents just answered the same customer ticket simultaneously. Hiver's collision alert ('Someone is typing a reply') did not show up on Chrome version 128. Is this a known bug?

Regards,
Chloe
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Chloe,

I am very sorry to hear about the double reply—we know how confusing that can be for customers. Collision detection relies on persistent WebSocket connections. If your company uses a VPN, ad-blocker, or firewall (like Zscaler), it can sometimes throttle WebSocket handshakes.

Please ensure your IT team whitelists `*.hiverhq.com` on port 443. Additionally, updating to our latest Chrome extension v11.4 ensures automatic fallback to long-polling if WebSockets are blocked.

Warm regards,
Hiver Support Team

subject: Hiver sidebar disappearing in Gmail after Chrome update
body:
Hi,

Several agents reported that the right-side Hiver panel in Gmail disappeared completely after their laptops updated to macOS Sequoia. How do we get it back?

Thanks,
Arun
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Arun,

This usually occurs when Chrome's hardware acceleration gets reset during an OS upgrade. Here is the 30-second fix:
1. In Chrome, go to `chrome://extensions` and toggle the Hiver extension OFF and then ON.
2. In Gmail, press `Cmd + Shift + R` to perform a hard cache reload.
3. Verify that third-party cookies are allowed under `chrome://settings/cookies` for `mail.google.com`.

If the sidebar does not reappear immediately, please let me know and I will generate an extension diagnostic log for your team.

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team

subject: Tab crash when drafting replies with large files
body:
Hello Support,

Our Gmail tabs crash with an out-of-memory error whenever we attach or edit drafts with large PDFs exceeding 15MB. How can our team work around this?

Thanks,
Nathan
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Nathan,

Thanks for reporting this. In extension version v11.4.1, inline attachment rendering in shared drafts can consume excess browser memory on files over 15MB. Our engineering team has released a patch in v11.4.2 to stream large attachments directly via Google Drive instead of client memory.

As an immediate workaround:
1. In Hiver Settings > General, temporarily disable 'Inline PDF Previews'.
2. Have agents update to extension v11.4.2 via chrome://extensions by clicking 'Update'.

Please let us know if the tab stability improves after updating.

Best regards,
Hiver Engineering Support

subject: Tag count displaying zero conversations in sidebar
body:
Hi Support,

We applied tags to several emails today but clicking the tag pill in the sidebar shows 0 conversations. Is there an indexing delay?

Regards,
Marcus
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for reaching out! When conversation tags show 0 conversations despite green tag pills, it usually indicates a local client cache desync with Gmail's label indexing.

Here are the troubleshooting steps to force an index refresh:
1. Perform a hard cache reload in Gmail using `Cmd + Shift + R` (or `Ctrl + F5` on Windows).
2. Navigate to Hiver Settings > Tags and click 'Re-index shared tags'.

If the tag counts do not update after trying these steps, please let us know and our engineering team can inspect the webhook sync logs for your workspace.

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team

subject: Offboarding employee - transfer assigned tickets
body:
Hello,

We have an employee leaving today (john@zenithcorp.org). How do we reassign all their open and pending tickets to another agent before removing their Google Workspace account?

Thanks,
Priya
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Priya,

Here are the quick steps to bulk reassign John's conversations before offboarding:

1. Go to your Shared Inbox in Gmail and click the search bar.
2. Filter by: `Assignee: john@zenithcorp.org` and status `Open`.
3. Click the 'Select All' checkbox at the top.
4. Click the 'Assign' dropdown icon and select the new agent or 'Unassigned'.

Once done, you can safely revoke John's seat in Hiver Admin Settings > Team Members without losing any conversation history.

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team

subject: SAML 2.0 SSO configuration guide for Okta
body:
Hi Hiver Support,

We need your ACS URL and Entity ID to set up Okta SAML Single Sign-On for our enterprise workspace.

Thanks,
David Chen
ground_truth_reply:
Hi David,

Here are our standard SAML 2.0 SSO parameters for Okta integration:
- **ACS URL:** `https://api.hiverhq.com/auth/saml/callback`
- **Entity ID / Audience URI:** `https://hiverhq.com/saml/metadata`
- **NameID Format:** `EmailAddress`

Once entered in your Okta admin portal, paste your Identity Provider Metadata XML into **Hiver Admin** > **Security** > **SAML SSO** and toggle 'Enforce SSO for all domain users'.

Please let me know if your security team needs a staging test before domain-wide rollout.

Best regards,
Hiver Enterprise Security
key_points: Navigation in Hiver Admin > Security > SAML SSO

subject: Google Workspace OAuth blocked app warning
body:
Hi Support,

Our domain admin console is blocking new users with an 'App not verified' error when installing Hiver. What exact app client ID do we whitelist in Google Admin?

Regards,
Samuel
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Samuel,

To whitelist Hiver across your Google Workspace domain:
1. Log into `admin.google.com` as a Super Admin.
2. Navigate to Security > Access and data control > API controls > Manage Third-Party App Access.
3. Click 'Add app' > 'OAuth App Name Or Client ID'.
4. Search for 'Hiver' or enter Client ID: `418829104-hiver.apps.googleusercontent.com`.
5. Select 'Trusted: Can access all Google services' and save.

New users will be able to sign in immediately without security warnings.

Best,
Hiver Enterprise Team

subject: Terrible downtime today - requesting cancellation and refund
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

Our support operations were paralyzed for two hours today during peak traffic because your extension crashed our Gmail tabs. This is completely unacceptable for an enterprise customer paying $1,500/month. We want to terminate our contract immediately and receive a refund for this month.

Robert Vance
VP Operations
ground_truth_reply:
Dear Robert,

I sincerely apologize for the disruption caused to your support operations today. There is no excuse for downtime during peak hours, and I completely understand your frustration.

I have flagged your account for urgent executive escalation to our Customer Success leadership and Platform Engineering leads. While our engineering team has deployed a patch resolving the memory leak in the Gmail extension, we want to address your commercial concerns directly.

Our Customer Success team will prioritize preparing a full Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and reviewing an appropriate service credit for your invoice. We are committed to making this right.

Sincerely,
Hiver Executive Escalations
key_points: Flag for executive escalation to Customer Success leadership

subject: How to configure auto-assignment round robin?
body:
Hi there,

Can we set up Hiver so incoming support tickets are evenly distributed among available online agents automatically without manual triage?

Thanks,
Karan
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Karan,

Yes, absolutely! You can achieve this using our Auto-Assignment (Round-Robin) feature:

1. Go to **Hiver Settings** > **Shared Inboxes** > Select your inbox.
2. Click on **Auto-Assignment** in the left menu.
3. Enable **Round-Robin Assignment** and select the active team members who should receive tickets.
4. (Optional) Check 'Assign only to online users' so tickets aren't routed to agents who are logged off.

Save changes, and any new unassigned email will instantly route evenly. Let me know if you run into any questions!

Best,
Hiver Support Team

subject: How to export CSAT survey results to CSV?
body:
Hi Support,

We need to run our monthly reporting on customer satisfaction scores. Where can an admin download raw CSAT responses for the previous 30 days?

Thanks,
Tom
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Tom,

Exporting CSAT data is straightforward:
1. Open **Hiver Analytics** from your Gmail sidebar.
2. Navigate to the **CSAT Reports** tab.
3. Set your date range filter to 'Last 30 days'.
4. In the top-right corner, click the **Export** button and choose **CSV (Raw Data)**.

You'll receive an email with the download link within 2 minutes. Let me know if you need help analyzing any of the fields!

Best,
Hiver Support Team

subject: Are internal notes visible to customers?
body:
Hi Hiver,

When we write internal notes on an email thread using @mentions, is there any possibility that an external customer could see these notes when receiving our reply?

Thanks,
Jessica
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Jessica,

Rest assured, Hiver Notes are 100% private to your internal team. Notes are visually rendered with a yellow background and stored entirely on Hiver's encrypted servers—they are never inserted into the email payload sent to external recipients.

Even when you reply to a customer, only the drafted email content is transmitted. Customers never receive or see any internal notes or colleague @mentions.

Best regards,
Hiver Support Team
key_points: Never included in email payload to customer

subject: Slack notifications stopped firing for new unassigned emails
body:
Hello,

Our integration between Hiver and Slack channel #ops-support stopped posting alerts when new emails arrive. We tried disconnecting and reconnecting Slack, but still no messages.

Best,
Siddharth
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Siddharth,

Thanks for reaching out. When reconnecting Slack, please ensure that the Hiver App bot is invited into the private `#ops-support` channel. If the channel is private, Slack blocks third-party bot notifications until you type `/invite @Hiver` in the channel.

Could you run that invite command in Slack and test sending an email? If it still fails, please let me know and I will inspect our webhook dispatch logs for your workspace.

Warm regards,
Hiver Support Team

subject: Webhook schema specification for conversation events
body:
Hi,

We are building a data sink for conversation events. Does your webhook payload provide metadata such as tags and assignee email, or only the conversation ID?

Regards,
Alex
ground_truth_reply:
Hi Alex,

Yes! Our webhook payload for `conversation.closed` and `conversation.updated` events includes full metadata:
- `conversation_id`: string
- `assignee`: { name, email }
- `tags`: array of string tag names
- `csat_score`: integer or null
- `timestamp_closed`: ISO-8601 string

You can review full JSON schema samples in our documentation at `https://developers.hiverhq.com/webhooks/schemas`.

Best regards,
Hiver API Support

subject: GDPR Right to be Forgotten protocol
body:
Privacy Officer,

What is your protocol and expected SLA for processing customer Right to Erasure requests under GDPR Article 17?

Regards,
Rachel Adams
ground_truth_reply:
Dear Rachel,

Thank you for reaching out. Under GDPR Article 17, Hiver coordinates customer data erasure requests with strict adherence to the statutory 30-day timeline.

When a formal erasure request is received, the ticket is routed to our Data Protection Officer (DPO) to coordinate a verified purge across all primary datastores, search indices, and rolling backup lifecycle stages. Our DPO will follow up directly with your compliance team upon completion to issue a formal Certificate of Data Destruction.

Sincerely,
Hiver Security & Compliance Team
key_points: Commit to 30 calendar days statutory SLA
Route to DPO and issue Certificate of Destruction
